title: A storybook
text: One day, Sam found a storybook on his way home.
Whose book is this? I can give it to Mrs Fox tomorrow.
Sam began to read the book. It was great fun.
Then he tried to put it in his schoolbag.
Did you see my storybook yesterday? It's blue.
